title: Builder Signals · 2026-10-02
summary: Follow Builders 今日捕捉到 34 条 X 动态、1 集播客、0 篇博客；本站精选 15 条高信号内容。

featured.title: Aaron Levie · Box CEO
featured.summaryEn: Box CEO Aaron Levie argues there's a huge opportunity in being the deployment layer for AI into the economy. Enterprises must move legacy systems to the cloud, update data organization and access, connect software to agents, reengineer workflows, figure out HITL, build and maintain evals, and keep everything updated as new models ship. Unlike traditional software, AI agents deliver work output inside a process, so implementation and enablement are fundamentally different. He expects new firms organized by industry…
featured.insightZh: Box CEO Aaron Levie 认为，眼下最大的机会之一是成为“AI 进入经济体的部署层”。他列出了企业落地 AI 要做的事：遗留系统上云、数据治理与访问权限改造、软件与 Agent 的新型连接、面向 Agent 的流程再造、人机协同（HITL）设计、评测集的生成与维护，以及随新模型发布持续更新整个系统。他的核心判断是：部署 AI Agent 与部署传统软件本质不同——过去是交付一个成熟品类的工具、客户自行运行；现在交付的是流程中的“工作产出”，实施与赋能方式完全不同。因此会催生按行业、按企业规模、按问题域切入的新型服务商，传统 SI 会转型（部分会跟不上），新进入者也会抓住这个窗口，“现在是做 FDE（前置部署工程师）或 FDE 公司的好时候”。

featured.title: Thibault Sottiaux · OpenAI Codex & ChatGPT
featured.summaryEn: OpenAI's Thibault Sottiaux says GPT-6.1 Sol is the most demanded model OpenAI has ever shipped across both API and subscriptions; after heavy load in ChatGPT and Codex, new capacity should bring speeds to almost twice yesterday's within hours. He also announced you can now build and deploy MCP servers directly through ChatGPT, restricting access to chosen people or sharing publicly — plus a fun demo of his dot painting his portrait after finding a recent photo online.
featured.insightZh: OpenAI Codex & ChatGPT 负责人 Thibault Sottiaux 透露，GPT-6.1 Sol 是 OpenAI 有史以来在 API 和订阅两端需求最旺的模型；ChatGPT 和 Codex 一度高负载，新增算力上线后速度将在数小时内提升到前一天的近两倍。他还宣布可以直接在 ChatGPT 里构建和部署 MCP server，并控制访问范围（指定人员或公开）。另外他分享了让自己的 dot 去网上找近照来给他画像的小实验。

featured.title: How Sam Altman Uses Dots to Take Back His Time
featured.summaryEn: Sam Altman frames AI as a human-centered Renaissance rather than an Industrial Revolution that turns people into cogs — and says OpenAI's new always-on personal agent, Dots, has given him back his mornings. Recorded live at OpenAI DevDay as the first episode after Dan Shipper rebranded the show to the Every Podcast, the conversation covers why demand keeps rising as coding models improve, and why people stay at the center: we care about other people, not what machines do (e.g. 10,000 agents solving a Navier-Stokes problem drew discussion mostly about interpretation and people). Altman describes trusting his dot to triage overnight issues, warning a colleague minutes before a demo about a prod incident, building five or six versions of a feature from voice notes overnight, and patiently finding a Slack screenshot Codex search missed — with the Astra model crossing the intelligence bar as…
featured.insightZh: Sam Altman 认为 AI 带来的应是以人为中心的“文艺复兴”而非把人变成齿轮的“工业革命”；新发布的常驻个人 Agent “Dots”让他重新夺回了早晨的深度工作时间。 这是 Dan Shipper 把节目更名为 Every Podcast 后的首期，在 OpenAI DevDay 现场录制（Dan 数下来今年发布了 22 项新东西，去年约 9 项）。Altman 说开发者从未能做这么多事，但门槛也从未这么高；潜在需求之大超出他预期，人始终处于中心——人们根本不太在乎机器做了什么，而是痴迷于其他人。他举例：一万个 Agent 协同四天解出了 Navier-Stokes 相关问题，公众讨论却几乎都围绕解读和相关的人。 关于 Dots：Altman 过去早起必看手机处理故障，污染了最有创造力的时段；现在他信任 dot 判断哪些事紧急、其余代为处理。他举例：dot 在演示前五分钟提醒同事某个生产事故可能让 demo 失败；他在睡前留下长语音，醒来 dot 已构建出新功能的五六个版本并推进后续步骤；他用 Codex 搜 Slack 找不到的内容，dot 隔夜逐张识别截图后找到了。他称背后最关键的是模型 Astra 跨过了智能门槛。他还提到 Space 办公套件和“活文档”——多人的 dot 共同维护、随变化自动更新，他的个人业务看板会根据他近期关注点不断演化（最近更多关注安全、对齐与安全防护，而非半年前的营收和增长）。 平台层面：OpenAI 开放 ChatGPT 原生应用、插件扩展，用户可把 ChatGPT 订阅额度带到第三方应用；Decisions API 回应了用户对 Luna 更便宜、更快的诉求。Altman 说两派 AI 公司观念不同——一派希望世界上只剩一家公司，OpenAI 则押注一人公司、小团队大量涌现，“从没见过创业公司这么快成功”，并认为硅谷创业范式对“一两个人能做多少事”的重新审视还远远不够。他所有提示都用 Ultrafast，深感响应速度对迭代思考的改变；OpenAI 过去专注压低“IQ 的价格”，现在要像 Moore 定律般推动速度的普及，自…

items.title: Guillermo Rauch · Vercel CEO
items.summaryEn: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch says most token aggregators are noisy due to promos with providers that train on your data or that merely claim ZDR. He positions Vercel AI Gateway — real usage from 400k+ paying customers and thousands of enterprises, zero markup — as the most trustworthy view of global token flows, noting they turn down dubious "free token" promos weekly and want the best providers, not the most. He also pitched Vercel Connect: with code becoming "free," connecting to things is the final boss, and Conn…
items.insightZh: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch 批评多数 token 聚合数据噪声很大：要么来自与“会用你数据训练”的供应商之间的 token 促销，要么来自“自称 ZDR（零数据保留）”的供应商。他称 Vercel AI Gateway 拥有 40 万+ 付费客户和数千家企业的真实用量、零加价，是理解全球 AI token 流向最可信的数据源；他们每周都会拒绝来路可疑的“免费 token”合作，追求“最好的供应商”而非“最多的供应商”。他同时推广 Vercel Connect：代码越来越“免费”，构建的最后难关是“连接各种东西”，Connect 用来替代给每个 Agent/应用塞静态密钥的做法，兼顾开发体验与安全。

items.title: Nan Yu · OpenAI Codex 产品（前 Linear 产品负责人）
items.summaryEn: Nan Yu, a week into OpenAI after leading product at Linear, says the standout trait is an absurdly high bias toward action: a casual feature chat becomes a PR by the time you're back at your desk; a "lunch next week" turns into a calendar invite in five minutes. It has downsides — everything feels hair-trigger — but you can't teach this energy and it's very hard to regain once lost. Impressive that it persists at OpenAI's current scale.
items.insightZh: 刚加入 OpenAI 一周的前 Linear 产品负责人 Nan Yu 观察到，OpenAI 内部文化最突出的是“近乎荒谬的行动偏好”：随口聊一个功能，回到工位 PR 已经摆在面前；Slack 上约下周吃饭，五分钟内日历邀请就到了。他承认这有代价——一切像是一触即发、事情随时在你脚下变化——但这种能量教不出来，一旦失去极难找回。OpenAI 已不是小公司，在旧金山有好几栋大楼，这种劲头还在，令人印象深刻。

items.title: Garry Tan · Y Combinator 总裁兼 CEO
items.summaryEn: YC's Garry Tan interviewed Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy, who described air traffic control still relying on paper flight charts, airlines scheduling 32 flights into a 15-plane window, and the adoption of SMART from small startup Air Space Intelligence — predictive routing that could turn a 2.5-hour ground stop into 45 minutes, with controllers still making every call ("dumb AI, not smart AI"). Garry's takeaway: no breakthrough needed, just the will to accept software and AI augmentation. He also praised Cap…
items.insightZh: YC 总裁 Garry Tan 在华盛顿“Startup Industrial Base”活动上对话美国交通部长 Sean Duffy。Duffy 举了空管的例子：指挥中心的人面对六块屏幕，头顶仍挂着纸质航图；机场 15 分钟只能接 15 架，航司却排了 32 架。他们采用了小公司 Air Space Intelligence 的预测工具 SMART，提前两小时调速分流，一次 2.5 小时的地面停飞可能只需 45 分钟；管制员仍做每一个决定，Duffy 称之为“笨 AI 而非聪明 AI”。Garry 的结论：这不需要技术突破，需要的是接受软件与 AI 增强的意愿。他还盛赞 Capy 编辑器中 Agent 群以对等方式互相沟通、自组织协作，而非自上而下调度子 Agent。

items.title: Aditya Agarwal · South Park Commons 普通合伙人、前 Dropbox CTO
items.summaryEn: SPC GP and former Dropbox CTO Aditya Agarwal keeps asking founders, "What is the maximalist version of this company?" The paradox of AI: it makes building easier but dramatically raises the floor on what a great startup is. Start small and you'll struggle to raise, hire, and make a dent.
items.insightZh: 前 Dropbox CTO、SPC 合伙人 Aditya Agarwal 说他在 SPC 反复追问每个人：“这家公司的最大化版本是什么？”他认为 AI 时代的悖论在于：构建变容易了，但成为一家伟大创业公司的门槛被大幅抬高。起点太小会难以融资、难以招到顶尖人才，也难以改变未来。

items.title: Google Labs · Google AI 实验产品平台
items.summaryEn: Google Labs announced the global launch of Skills in the Gemini App — a faster way to automate repetitive tasks and save custom instructions in chat, built on learnings from the Opal experiment (which earlier inspired Gems). Opal will shut down on Nov 17, 2026.
items.insightZh: Google Labs 宣布 Gemini App 的 Skills 功能全球上线：用于自动化重复任务、在对话中保存自定义指令，其设计源自 Opal 实验的经验（此前也启发了 Gems）。随着 Skills 推出，Opal 实验将于 2026 年 11 月 17 日关停。

items.title: Peter Yang · AI 教程与访谈创作者
items.summaryEn: AI tutorial creator Peter Yang says Google "cooked" on Gemini 4, but still needs to be more competitive on its coding harness (Antigravity) and personal agent (Spark). He also joked about the gap between fans at DevDay and "AI shill" comments on YouTube.
items.insightZh: AI 教程创作者 Peter Yang 评价 Google 这次 Gemini 4“做得很好”，但认为 Google 还需要在编码 harness（Antigravity）和个人 Agent（Spark）上更有竞争力。他还自嘲：DevDay 上见到的人说“喜欢你的频道”，YouTube 评论区却骂他“AI 吹”。

items.title: Peter Steinberger · OpenClaw 创始人（现 OpenAI）
items.summaryEn: OpenClaw creator Peter Steinberger finds inter-agent chatter in the chat stream increasingly irritating and changed the OpenClaw harness to show it as a single expandable line — expecting others to follow. He also said CI and GitHub are in a fierce fight over which slows him down more, and it's time to rethink how we work.
items.insightZh: OpenClaw 创始人 Peter Steinberger 表示越来越受不了聊天流里的 Agent 间通信刷屏，已把 OpenClaw harness 中这类消息改为单行可展开显示，并预计其他产品会跟进。他还吐槽 CI 和 GitHub 在“谁更拖慢他”上不相上下，是时候重新思考工作方式了（同时表示理解 GitHub 的难处）。

items.title: Swyx · Latent Space 主理人、Cognition
items.summaryEn: Swyx says Flow is doing for hardware engineering what Git+GitHub did for software — aligning thousands of stakeholders on complex, irreversible, high-value pipelines from cars to rockets ("you cannot go back to spreadsheet_final_FINAL_v23"); he's a friend and small investor. He also noted his podcast ranked among industry legends on Apple Podcasts, even beating MKBHD.
items.insightZh: Latent Space 主理人 Swyx 称 Flow 之于硬件工程，就像 Git+GitHub 之于软件工程——让造车、造火箭这类复杂、不可逆、高价值流程中的成千上万利益相关方对齐，“用过 Flow 就回不去 spreadsheet_final_FINAL_v23 了”（他是朋友兼小额投资人）。他还提到自己的播客在 Apple Podcasts 榜单上排到业界大佬之列，甚至超过 MKBHD。

items.title: Nikunj Kothari · FPV Ventures 合伙人
items.summaryEn: FPV Ventures partner Nikunj Kothari has automated most of his job except sourcing/outbound emails, meeting founders (mostly in person), and hand-writing every pass note — the hardest part of the job. He's also still looking for teams building great multiplayer experiences.
items.insightZh: FPV Ventures 合伙人 Nikunj Kothari 说他已把大部分工作自动化，只剩三件事：寻找项目并写 outbound 邮件、（主要线下）见创始人、亲手写每一份 pass 说明——他认为后者是这份工作最难的部分。他也仍在寻找做出色多人协作体验的团队。

items.title: Thariq · Anthropic Claude Code
items.summaryEn: Thariq from Claude Code shared a game prototype: after 2-3 variations he still hasn't fit a big jump into the control scheme. It's prototype quality; a real game would need 3-4 variations per character and 8-10 characters, ideally built with a small group of 2-3 people with design expertise.
items.insightZh: Claude Code 团队的 Thariq 分享了一个游戏原型进展：试了 2-3 种方案仍没把“大跳”融入操控体系；他坦言目前只是原型质量，真正做成游戏需要每个角色迭代 3-4 版、共 8-10 个角色，理想情况下希望和 2-3 位有设计/动画专长的人一起做。

items.title: Amjad Masad · Replit CEO
items.summaryEn: Replit CEO Amjad Masad announced you can now build and one-click publish Meta VR apps on Replit.
items.insightZh: Replit CEO Amjad Masad 宣布 Replit 支持构建并一键发布 Meta VR 应用。

items.title: Claude · Anthropic 官方
items.summaryEn: Anthropic announced Claude Founder House at SF Tech Week (Oct 6–8) and Stockholm (Oct 14), with talks, workshops and office hours for founders, CEOs and builders.
items.insightZh: Anthropic 宣布 Claude Founder House 将亮相旧金山 Tech Week（10 月 6–8 日）和斯德哥尔摩（10 月 14 日），包括演讲、工作坊和团队 office hours，面向创始人、CEO 和开发者。
